name: MqttDataPanel

props.name: onClearRetained
props.description: Raises a clear request; DataView confirms it and performs the clear.

props.name: onClearRetainedBelow
props.description: Raises a bulk clear request for topics below the right-clicked one.

props.name: pinnedTopicsStore
props.description: This connection's pinned topics, shared with the selected-topic panel.

props.name: pinnedExpansionStore
props.description: What is open inside the pinned block, per pin, owned by DataView so it survives a remount. A branch pinned from this window opens its own first level here.

props.name: onRequestRebirth
props.description: Opens the rebirth confirmation for the Sparkplug view's node and bulk actions.

notes: Figma is not linked yet; this story uses local Storybook fixtures. The List/Sparkplug mode toggle only renders once the connection has seen Sparkplug traffic. The pinned block's dragged height is kept with the app's panel sizes, one entry per connection. A right-click in the pinned block adds "Show in tree" to the topic menu.
